findings.message: The target contract and sequence diagram match the accepted pure-function scope: health() has no inputs, returns a fresh object exactly {"status":"ok"}, and introduces no I/O, HTTP service or dependencies. No architectural blocker was identified.

Node ES module execution and the preserved test command are supported by the supplied package evidence. Planned shape and freshness checks cover the central return-value contract. Implementation and tests are explicitly pending, so their correctness has not been demonstrated by this package.

The statement that GitHub CI validates fixture behavior through the suite PR is not independently supported by the supplied sources. Treat this as an integration assumption until workflow configuration or an actual CI result is available; it does not block the function-only architecture.

API, contracts, testing and CI/CD are the applicable declared concerns. Excluding transport, persistence, authentication and the other infrastructure concerns is consistent with the accepted pure-function scope. The authoritative source explicitly records a simulated human freeze decision for architecture version 1.0.0.
